title: Actionbar Clock
description: Simply adds a clock to your actionbar.
body:
This datapack simply adds a clock in your actionbar, it counts days, hours, minutes, and seconds. Use this if you want to know how old your world is. (counts in real world time)

There are **2** trigger commands:
- `/trigger clock`
  - use to turn on/off the clock
- `/trigger calibrate`
  - use to calibrate the clock in case you reset the scoreboards used
  - is run in the `load.mcfunction` to calibrate it in an already created world
